item.title: A Typical pathfindR Workflow
item.description: pathfindR is an R package for pathway/gene-set enrichment analysis that does something most enrichment tools don’t: instead of testing your gene list directly, it first maps your genes onto a protein–protein interaction network (PIN), finds active subnetworks (connected groups of interacting genes that are enriched for significantly altered genes), and then runs enrichment on those subnetworks. The payoff is that genes which don’t pass your significance cutoff on their own (but sit in the middle of a cluster of genes that do) still get a chance to contribute.
